scenes.a: If tonight feels heavy with things that did not go as planned, lay them down.
scenes.sub: GOD WORKS ALL THINGS FOR GOOD

scenes.a: Romans 8:28 promises that all things work together for good to those who love God.
Lord, as the dark falls, I release the pieces I could not fix today.
You see every unseen struggle, every broken plan, and every silent tear.
Transform my quiet worry into rest, trusting that Your hand is weaving even this trial into something good.
Wrap me in Your peace tonight, knowing my life rests safely in Your purpose.
Subscribe to The Secret Place for daily bedtime prayers.
